ab_design: Both arms ran the same tree and binaries back to back. The only difference is GGUF_T16_SELECTED_C1_VARIANTS_BY_QUANT_SHAPE: populated for the candidate, {} for the baseline. The route is the selected Q5 MoE down projection, which this model materializes in the qmicro planar layout (gguf_q5_k_qmicro_t16_v1).

correctness.contract: The qmicro local32 owner matches the production qmicro tile8 owner at the production shape and at shared-x/batched row contracts: max relative error <= 5e-4, correlation >= 0.9999. Verified RED: sabotaging the metadata record index or the row-to-x mapping fails the test.
correctness.route_live: Counted in the measured sweep decode: 74 resolutions of gguf_q5_k_qmicro_t16_v1 + selected_t16_local32_gemv_decode_bf16_bf16_out for a 128/16 workload, so the neutral aggregate is not a routing miss.

decision: Retained and promoted to the default path: exact, non-regressive, and a measured isolated cycle win at the production shape. The end-to-end decode rate on this model/protocol is neutral, so this is not a scoreboard row and no topline metric is claimed.

kernel_cycle_evidence.method: Isolated launch timing at the production selected-down geometry (in=512, out=2048, experts=256, rows=8, x_rows=8), 400 iterations after warmup, synthetic Q5_K weights repacked to each layout.
kernel_cycle_evidence.note: The isolated cycle win does not move the end-to-end decode rate on this model/protocol, so it is retained as a kernel-level sub-window win only. No in-decode kernel trace accompanies it: rocprofv3 hangs in this environment and the measured decode is graph-captured, so per-kernel HIP event timing is rejected inside the capture.
